subject: Offline update authorization matrix & handoff checklist for Island Bank VPC
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <srao@islandbank.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-14T15:12:00Z
Subject: Offline update authorization matrix & handoff checklist for Island Bank VPC

Hi Samir,

Following up from the call yesterday — attached is the first draft of the offline update authorization matrix and the handoff checklist we'll use for the air-gapped appliance deliveries. This focuses on the offline artifact flow (signed image bundles -> courier -> on-site ingestion) and the minimum approvers for each step.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm the on-site custodian role (name / email) who will sign the physical receipt.
- Confirm any mandatory audit observers (e.g., internal compliance team or third-party).
- Any SLA restrictions on allowable maintenance windows for your core banking hosts.

Key notes in the draft:
- All images will be signed with our KMS HSM key; we will also produce a detached SHA256 manifest signed with an HSM timestamp.
- Island Bank must verify signatures using the accompanying public key (we've included verification steps in the README).
- Transfer medium options: encrypted USB in tamper-evident pouch (preferred) OR courier-paired encrypted SSD (for larger bundles).
- The handoff requires two-person sign-off on physical receipt and a one-hour connectivity test window after installation.

Attachments: 20270414-offline-manifest-v2.yaml, handoff-authorization-matrix.xlsx

I'll schedule a 30-min sync next week to walk through the matrix with EdgeOps and compliance. Proposed times: Tue/Wed 9:00-11:00 PT.

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192


From: Samir Rao <srao@islandbank.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: EdgeOps Team <edgeops@islandbank.com>, KPMG Audit <audit@kpmg.com>
Date: 2027-04-15T08:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Offline update authorization matrix & handoff checklist for Island Bank VPC

Thanks Monica — this looks thorough. A couple of clarifying items before we confirm the custodian: 

1) Can you detail the rollback signer flow? If an image fails post-install, who can authorize the rollback and what artifacts are required to validate the rollback image?

2) For the tamper-evident medium, do you have recommended vendors for pouches/SSD packaging that meet banking-grade chain-of-custody requirements?

3) On the verification step: will Redwood provide a verification utility we can run on an isolated host (no internet) to confirm signatures + checksums? If so, we need the cryptographic verification steps documented for our internal auditors.

Last: our compliance folks would prefer a pre-signed consent form for emergency rollbacks (i.e., pre-authorized rollback under defined conditions). Can your legal/compliance team provide a template we can vet with KPMG?

Regards,
Samir Rao
Head of Edge Operations | Island Bank
srao@islandbank.com


From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-21T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Offline update authorization matrix & handoff checklist for Island Bank VPC

Monica / Dev — looping in technical clarifications and proposed changes based on Samir's questions.

- Rollback signer flow: we propose a two-tier authorization. Minor rollbacks (hotfixes within same major version) can be authorized by on-call EdgeOps (two-person approval: on-site custodian + remote Redwood engineer via signed ticket). Major rollbacks (downgrade of model weights or core runtime revert) require executive sign-off (monica + Island Bank security lead) and a signed rollback manifest. The rollback manifest is a signed YAML listing artifacts + SHA256 checksums, signed by Redwood HSM and countersigned by Island Bank custodian.

- Verification utility: Dev has prepared an offline verification binary (linux x86_64 static) that validates signatures and manifests using a bundled public key. It runs without network access. We'll include a verification checklist and an expected exit code matrix for automation.

- Packaging vendors: we recommend SecureSeal Co. (tamper-evident pouches) and CryoTransit for SSD crates — both have audit trails and chain-of-custody documentation. We'll share vendor reference docs in the Drive folder.

Action items for this thread: 
1) Monica: provide a pre-signed emergency rollback template to Samir by 2027-04-23.
2) Dev: attach the verification utility and README to Drive (INF-4821).
3) Markus: update the authorization matrix to include rollback categories and countersign flow; send updated version for sign-off.

-Markus

Attachments referenced: transfer-log-template.csv

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <srao@islandbank.com>, EdgeOps Team <edgeops@islandbank.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-28T18:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Offline update authorization matrix & handoff checklist for Island Bank VPC

Samir — thanks for the prompt review and useful questions. Quick update and next steps: 

1) Emergency rollback template: attached (Doc: pre-signed-rollback-template.pdf). This document explains conditions, authorized signers, and the countersign process. If Island Bank legal wants edits, send redlines and we will iterate.

2) Verification utility + README: Dev has uploaded the static verifier and a step-by-step checklist to the Drive link (see related_links). The verifier returns exit code 0 on success, 2 for missing artifact, 3 for signature mismatch.

3) Packaging: we're happy to validate SecureSeal/CryoTransit references with your procurement team. We will also add a tamper-evident sticker serial check into the transfer-log-template.csv so your on-site custodian can record seal serials at handoff.

4) Proposed pilot: one offline image transfer next month (May 12) during a 2-hour maintenance window starting 02:00 PT. Timeline: courier arrival -> two-person sign-off -> ingestion -> 30-min verification -> smoke tests -> finalize transfer-log.

Please confirm custodian name by EOD Mon 2027-05-03 and whether we should proceed with the pilot window.

Thanks — ccing Grace for compliance oversight.

--
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
